Under the direction of the Environmental Program Manager I (Supervisory), the Senior Environmental Scientist Specialist (SES Spec) leads the coordination of activities of ERIHC from within the NS\&C Program. The SES (Spec) is the program lead, responsible for ensuring that the program commitments are met. The SES will provide technical coordination and training to CACs, administrative support staff, collaborating agencies, and other contractors related to the program’s commitments and objectives. The SES (Spec) must also establish effective working relationships and maintain cooperative liaison relationships with government agencies, agricultural industry, and the general public. If you are interested in becoming part of a diverse and inclusive workforce where talent, experience, and expertise are valued, then CDFA is the place for you!!  

This CDFA work location is near restaurants, coffee shops, and a farmer’s market. We are within walking distance to light rail/public transportation, across the street from beautiful Capitol Park, and two miles from Downtown Commons (DOCO).  

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. The CDFA does not participate in E\-Verify for employment authorization purposes.

The duties of this job are performed indoors approximately ninety percent (90%) of the time in an office. The remainder of the time is spent traveling to meetings or district offices, outdoor locations, warehouses or facilities of industrial hemp production or sale. The employee may be exposed to extremes in temperature, dust, fumes, gases, and odors.  

  

Overnight and/or extended travel to various locations throughout the State may be required to accomplish work objectives in various environments. State vehicles are used to travel to these worksites. Rental vehicles and/or air travel may also be used.

jobs.title: Project Level Environmental Geologist / Scientist
jobs.description:
**Employment Opportunity:** 

**Project Level Environmental Geologist / Scientist**   
**Weber, Hayes \& Associates** 

Our well\-established Monterey Bay\-located environmental consulting firm (www.weber\-hayes.com) is seeking a full time Project Level Geologist/Scientist for a mix of project management, field work, reporting and technical support related to range of environmental investigation, remediation, and compliance services. Our firm completes agency\-required evaluations needed to assess chemical releases (groundwater, soil and soil vapor), drinking water supply, stormwater and other regulated environmental compliance investigations for a wide range of clients. The ideal candidate is an intelligent, motivated, and detail\-oriented team player who is at least 2 to 4 years into their career as an environmental geologist / scientist. If you are seeking employment with a small firm where you are valued and can choose your career path with our support as you learn what excites you, then please apply.

The primary focus of this position will be to collaborate with and support geologists/engineers with all aspects of project management, budgeting, planning, field data collection, and compilation of technical reports. Work would involve interfacing with our staff, clients, and regulatory agencies from the local to State levels. Candidate qualification considerations include:

* BS degree in Geology, Environmental Science or another related technical field.
* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER Training.
* Other beneficial (but not required) certifications include, Geologist\-in\-Training, Stormwater QSD/QSP/QISD/QISP, and/or Professional Registration.

The job will include a broad mix of field and office work – the candidate must:

* Possess basic knowledge of contaminant fate and transport in environmental media, environmental sampling techniques and remediation technologies.
* Have familiarity with laboratory analytical methods for typical contaminants of concern found in environmental media.
* Possess strong technical writing and oral communication skills and able to meet schedule deadlines.
* Have proficiency with standard word processing and database programs (Microsoft Word/Excel/Power Point, Adobe Acrobat, etc.).
* Have the ability to read, interpret and apply information on State and Federal technical guidance, and regulations, and compliance determinations.
* Be self\-motivated and self\-directed, able\-bodied, and hardworking (ability to stoop, kneel, climb, lift up to 50 pounds, and working occasional long days).
* Have a valid, current California Driver’s License, and,
* Have 2\-4 years\-experience in a related field.
* This position requires relocation to the Monterey Bay Area and regular in\-office attendance

GENERAL PROJECT GEOLOGIST / SCIENTIST RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

* Design environmental field investigations and prepare technical documents including work plans, site assessment reports, feasibility studies, and remedial action plans.
* Manage multiple projects at any one given time, including the preparation and management of project budgets, meeting project deadlines, and ensuring effective client and regulatory agency communication and relation.
* Perform a wide range of fieldwork tasks, including subcontractor management, logging soil borings, overseeing groundwater monitoring / remediation well installations, UST removals, remedial excavations, and collecting soil, groundwater, surface water, soil vapor and indoor air samples, as well as documenting field activities.
* Set up field projects, including permitting, hiring subcontractors; coordinating with staff, laboratories, and subcontractors; and obtaining necessary materials and equipment.
* Perform data management, review, and synthesis.
* Prepare technical reports documenting fieldwork and results.
* Willingness to travel to project sites throughout central California.
* Maintain a positive attitude and be a team player.

COMPENSATION

Annual salary starts at $82K to $92K based on experience and pay increases are based on performance. This position includes medical, dental and prescription plan health benefits, profit\-sharing bonuses (typically no less than $15\-20K per year), and 401(k) plan with employer match. Other benefits include ten (10\) paid holidays per year, paid vacation time, and use of a company vehicle. This career\-based position will naturally progress into a Senior Geologist / Scientist role and beyond, with the right applicant.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $97,000\.00 \- $112,000\.00 per year

**Data Analyst Sr, Finance \- Encounter Data (Covered California)**  

  

**CalOptima**  

  

**Join Us in this Amazing Opportunity**  

  

**The Team You'll Join**  

  

We are a mission driven community\-based organization that serves member health with excellence and dignity, respecting the value and needs of each person. If you are ready to advance your career while making a difference, we encourage you to review and apply today and help us build healthier communities for all.  

  

**More About the Opportunity**
  

  

We are hoping you will join us as a **Data Analyst Sr, Finance \- Encounter Data (Covered California)** and help shape the future of healthcare where you'll be an integral part of our **FIN \- Encounters** team, helping to strive for excellence while we serve our member health with dignity, respecting the value and needs of each of our members through collaboration with our providers, community partners and local stakeholders. This position has been approved to be **Partial Telework**.  

  

  

* *If telework is approved, you are required to work within the State of California only and if Partial Telework, also come in to the Main Office in Orange, CA, at least two (2\) days per week minimum.*

  

  

The Data Analyst Sr (Finance \- Encounter Data) will support the data reporting responsibilities of the Encounters team within the Finance department. You will support with the maintenance of current Encounter tasks, such as monitoring and reviewing the 5010 837 files submissions. You will create and maintain Standard Query Language (SQL) queries to reconcile data for new projects, including submission testing with vendors for the outbound process with the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) and the Centers for Medicare \& Medicaid Services (CMS) and to continually improve data acquisition and reporting methods. You will ensure timely, complete and accurate data submissions inbound and outbound with the Information Technology (IT) team. Together, we are building a stronger, more equitable health system.

* 90% \- Data Support
	+ Participates in a mission\-driven culture of high\-quality performance, with a member focus on customer service, consistency, dignity and accountability.
	+ Assists the team in carrying out department responsibilities and collaborates with others to support short\- and long\-term goals/priorities for the department.
	+ Supports the Encounter team with the maintenance of data through SQL tables.
	+ Works with other departments to ensure complete and accurate data is being processed appropriately, which impacts DHCS and CMS, such as coordinating with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) on any technical assistance for Encounter Data issues for 5010 837 data submissions.
	+ Coordinates with Claims Administration and IT teams to work on improving encounter data submissions.
	+ Assists with reconciling data in the SQL tables through the many processes of the Encounters Submission.
	+ Provides expertise in data analysis, including members, providers, encounters and claims data.
	+ Prepares and reviews analytics methods to verify data integrity of claims and inbound 837 encounters.
	+ Creates detailed business requirements for technical programs, including implementation of new processing platforms for new and existing vendors.
	+ Interacts with existing delegated health networks to establish and maintain strong working relationships.
	+ Stays current on the DHCS, CMS and Covered California data reporting requirements and reports on any changes that affect CalOptima Health and/or health networks.
	
	Refers complex data integrity issues to the manager for further evaluation and action as needed.  
	+
5% \- Completes other projects and duties as assigned.  
*

* 3 years of experience in Medi\-Cal managed care or Medicare Advantage required.
* Covered California (Commercial) experience required.

* 4 years of experience in an Independent Physician Association (IPA), hospital or health plan setting.

**CDSS \- QUALITY CONTROL PROGRAM COORDINATOR (SUPERVISOR)**

**100% Onsite \- Los Angeles CA 90056**

**What We're Looking For:**


We are seeking a CDSS Quality Control Program Coordinator to supervise and manage program monitoring of the CDSS department workflows, data collection, file audits, and reports to achieve the department compliance goals while managing and providing direct support and supervision to department Quality Control Program Specialists. The Quality Control Program Coordinator is primarily responsible for California Department of Social Services (CDSS) program quality management oversight and working with department quality control program specialists to ensure contract compliance with the CDSS childcare subsidy contracts workflow.

**RESPONSIBILITIES: PROGRAM \& CONTRACT QUALITY MGT. OVERSIGHT**
================================================================

* Maintain and monitor ongoing audit compliance checks for the CDSS Department.
* Ensure quality management oversight including review of all proposed contract changes, to ensure contract integrity is implemented as required by the CDSS.
* Monitor and ensure the findings reports are completed each quarter for assigned programs
* Analyze key program indicators to ensure program viability.
* Plan and implement strategies that are in line with agency goals, contract requirements and will increase productivity and compliance.
* Partner with the Family Services Manager to ensure corrective and preventative actions are detected for continuous improvement initiatives.
* Make sure all documents are up\-to\-date and accurate.
* At the direction of the Family Services Manager, serve as an agency representative for CDSS, LA Alliance agencies, CAPPA etc.), represent program and agency at professional organizations, community meetings, trainings, and meetings with funding agencies.
* Work as a liaison with other departments to facilitate inter\-departmental communication regarding general work with other departments to mitigate risk.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES: MANAGEMENT**

* Supervise, mentor, and guide department quality control specialists to identify staff development and training needs.
* Provide direction, leadership, and coaching to department quality control specialists by conducting periodic check\-ins.
* Ensure that performance goals are set and met using performance expectations and standards that have been clearly communicated to staff.
* Resolve conflicts effectively and follow disciplinary procedures, and conduct fair and impartial performance appraisals using agency policies and procedures.

 **EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES YOU SHOULD POSSESS**:

* Bachelor of Science/Arts degree from an accredited university in Business Management, Business Data Analytics, Education, Public Administration, Child Development, Social Services or related field. Related work experience in case management or compliance may be substituted for college level education.
